present our IPs in diverse forms and unlock more commercial possibilities.       可能性。近年來集團業績的高速增長，一定程
In recent years, the Group’s rapid performance growth has, to some extent,       度上掩蓋了子業務的光芒。但對於創新業務，
overshadowed the achievements of our sub-businesses. Nevertheless,               我們始終保持細心呵護的態度，不追求激進增

and continuous iteration through practice. The market demand for happiness

consumption brand with genuine global reach. Following a period of               響力的世界級文化消費品牌。但經歷了「F1直線
“F1-style” rapid acceleration, we expect 2026 to be a year of “pausing in the    衝刺」後，我們希望2026年是「進到維修站、加

expansion, we aim to take measured stock of our operations, consolidate          我們希望稍作修整，積蓄力量，實現更健康的

linear corporate growth and enhance the overall operational resilience of the

     MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
     管理層討論與分析


     BUSINESS REVIEW                                                                    業務回顧
     2025 marks the 15th anniversary of Pop Mart’s establishment. In this               2025 年是泡泡瑪特成立的第十五週年。在這個
     milestone year, the Group has further accelerated its global expansion,            具有里程碑意義的年份，本集團全球化進程進
     with brand recognition rising consistently and the boundaries of its               一步提速，品牌知名度持續提升，創意表達邊
     creative expression being continuously expanded, as we keep driving the            界不斷拓寬，持續推動流行文化生態的發展。
     development of the pop culture ecosystem. Benefiting from the close                得益於各部門的緊密協作，以及持續提升的IP運
     collaboration across all departments and the ongoing enhancement of                營與產品研發能力，我們在為消費者提供優質
     our IP operation and product R&D capabilities, we have not only delivered          服務的同時，推出多款深受全球消費者歡迎的
     high-quality services to consumers but also launched a host of new IPs and         新IP及新品系列。進一步提升了泡泡瑪特品牌及
     product lines that are well-received by global consumers. This has further         旗下IP在全球範圍內的認可度，並推動銷售業績
     elevated the global recognition of the Pop Mart brand and its affiliated           實現高速增長。2025 年，我們實現收入人民幣
     IPs, and fueled rapid growth in the Group’s sales performance. In 2025, we         37,120.1百萬元，同比增長184.7%。
     recorded a revenue of RMB37,120.1 million, with a year-on-year growth of
     184.7%.


     IP Incubation and Operation                                                        IP孵化與運營
     IP operation and creative design are the core drivers to promote Pop Mart’s        IP運營與創意設計是推動泡泡瑪特持續健康發展
     sustainable and healthy growth. As a world-leading IP platform, the Group          的核心驅動力。作為全球領先的 IP 平台，本集
     identifies artists and designers with high potential worldwide and has             團在全球範圍內挖掘極具潛力的藝術家和設計
     successfully created a number of IP images through a well-established IP           師，憑藉成熟的IP運營體系，成功打造出多個廣

Reasons for Adoption of the Contractual Arrangements                             採納合約安排的理由
The Relevant Businesses of Paqu Huyu are subject to foreign investment           葩趣互娛的相關業務受相關中國法律法規之外
restrictions in accordance with relevant PRC laws and regulations. Paqu          商投資限制規限。葩趣互娛目前持有ICP許可證
Huyu currently holds an ICP License and an ICB License, which are required       及 I C B 許可證，均為營運相關業務所必需的。

         Climate resilience                                                           氣候韌性
         In response to long-term risks and uncertainties brought forth by            為應對氣候變化帶來的長期風險與不確定
         climate change, we have carried out a climate-related scenario analysis      性，圍繞上述識別的重要氣候相關風險，
         focusing on the important climate-related risks identified above. We aim     我們開展了氣候相關情景分析，旨在評估
         to assess the Group’s adaptation and recoverability (“climate resilience”)   本集團在未來不同氣候與社會經濟發展路
         under different climates and social and economic development paths,          徑下的適應與恢復能力（即「氣候韌性」），
         systematically measure the possible financial and strategic impacts of       系統衡量氣候變化可能帶來的財務與戰略
         climate changes, and support the integration of climate factors into         影響，支持推動氣候因素納入戰略規劃、
         strategic planning, risk management, and investment decision-making          風險管理和投資決策流程，提升企業運營
         processes to enhance the climate resilience of corporate operations.         的氣候韌性。


         Based on the climate risk exposure of the business model, we focus           基於業務模式氣候風險敞口，我們重點評
         on evaluating the impacts of climate-related physical risks on the           估氣候相關物理風險對公司核心業務的影
         Company’s core business, and refer to the model parameters to evaluate       響，並參考模型參數評估氣候相關風險影
         the degree of impact of climate-related risks, in order to provide a         響程度，為風險定價、資本管理和業務規
         decision-making basis for risk pricing, capital management and business      劃提供決策依據。
         planning.

Reporting Principles
匯報原則
A description of, or an explanation on, the application of the following Reporting Principles in the preparation    About This Report
of the ESG report:                                                                                                  關於本報告
描述或解釋在編備環境、社會及管治報告時如何應用下列匯報原則：
Materiality: The ESG report should disclose: (i) the process to identify and the criteria for the selection of
material ESG factors; (ii) if a stakeholder engagement is conducted, a description of significant stakeholders
identified, and the process and results of the issuer’s stakeholder engagement.
重要性：環境、社會及管治報告應披露：(i)識別重要環境、社會及管治因素的過程及選擇這些因素的準
則；(ii)如發行人已進行持份者參與，已識別的重要持份者的描述及發行人持份者參與的過程及結果。
Quantitative: Information on the standards, methodologies, assumptions and/or calculation tools used, and
source of conversion factors used, for the reporting of emissions/energy consumption (where applicable)
should be disclosed.
量化：有關匯報排放量 ╱ 能源耗用（如適用）所用的標準、方法、假設及 ╱ 或計算工具的資料，以及所
使用的轉換因素的來源應予披露。
Consistency: The issuer should disclose in the ESG report any changes to the methods or KPIs used, or any
other relevant factors affecting a meaningful comparison.
一致性：發行人應在環境、社會及管治報告中披露統計方法或關鍵績效指標的變更（如有）或任何其他影
響有意義比較的相關因素。

      26.           An issuer shall disclose information that enables an understanding of the

                    issuer shall disclose:

                    人了解發行人的策略及業務模式對氣候相關變化、發展或不確定性的韌
                    性。發行人須按與其情況相稱的做法，使用與氣候相關的情景分析來評估
                    其氣候韌性。提供量化資訊時，發行人可披露單一數額或區間範圍。具體
                    而言，發行人須披露：

(e)           the issuer’s planned use of carbon credits to offset greenhouse gas emissions to
              achieve any net greenhouse gas emissions target. In explaining its planned use
              of carbon credits, the issuer shall disclose:
              發行人計劃使用碳信用抵銷溫室氣體排放以實現任何溫室氣體排放淨額目
              標。關於使用碳信用的計劃，發行人須披露：
(i)           the extent to which, and how, achieving any net greenhouse gas emissions
              target relies on the use of carbon credits;
              依賴使用碳信用以實現任何溫室氣體排放淨額目標的程度及方式；
(ii)          which third-party scheme(s) will verify or certify the carbon credits;
              該碳信用將由哪些第三方計劃驗證或認證；
(iii)         the type of carbon credit, including whether the underlying offset will be
              nature-based or based on technological carbon removals, and whether the
              underlying offset is achieved through carbon reduction or removal; and
              碳信用的類型，包括相關抵銷是否是基於自然還是基於科技的碳消除，以
              及相關抵銷是通過減碳還是碳消除實現；及
(iv)          any other factors necessary to enable an understanding of the credibility and
              integrity of the carbon credits the issuer plans to use (for example, assumptions
              regarding the permanence of the carbon offset).
              為讓人了解發行人計劃使用的碳信用的可信度和完整性所必需的任何其他
              重要因素（例如，對碳抵銷效果的假設）。

      3.2 Capital management                                                          3.2 資本管理
         The Group’s objectives when managing capital are to safeguard the              本集團管理資本之目的為維持其持續經營
         Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide             的能力，以便為本集團擁有人提供回報，
         returns for owners of the Group and to maintain an optimal capital             並維持最佳的資本架構以提高擁有人的長
         structure to enhance owners’ value in the long term.                           期價值。


         The Group monitors capital on the basis of the gearing ratio. This ratio       本集團按照資本負債率監控資本。該比率
         is calculated as net debt divided by total capital. Net debt is calculated     按債務淨額除以總資本計算。債務淨額按
         as total borrowings less cash and cash equivalents. Total capital is           借款總額減去現金及現金等價物計算。總
         calculated as ‘equity’ as shown in the balance sheet plus net debt. As at      資 本 按 資 產 負 債 表 所 示「 權 益 」加 債 務 淨
         31 December 2025, the Group has no net debt. See Note 34(c) for the            額計算。於2025 年12 月31 日，本集團並無
         reconciliation of net cash for the year ended 31 December 2025 and             債務淨額。有關截至2025 年及2024 年12 月
         2024.                                                                          31 日止年度現金淨額的對賬，請參閱附註

         The acquisition method of accounting is used to account for business           非共同控制下的業務合併使用收購會計法

         •    fair values of the assets transferred                                     •   所轉讓資產的公平值

         •    equity interests issued by the Group                                      •   本集團發行的股權

              consideration arrangement, and                                                債之公平值；及

         Identifiable assets acquired and liabilities and contingent liabilities        於業務合併中收購的可識別資產以及承擔
         assumed in a business combination are, with limited exceptions,                的負債及或然負債初步按其於收購日期的
         measured initially at their fair values at the acquisition date. The Group     公平值計量（少數例外情況除外）。本集團
         recognises any non-controlling interest in the acquired entity on              以公平值或非控股權益所佔被收購實體的
         an acquisition-by-acquisition basis either at fair value or at the non-        可識別資產淨值之適當比例按逐項收購基

         identifiable assets.
